configuration.name: ingester.query-store-max-look-back-period
configuration.effective_default_rule: For shipper target all, zero becomes max_chunk_age + shard/upload delay + index-cache validity + 3*resync interval +5m; initQuerier propagates nonzero value and overrides query_ingesters_within precedence.
configuration.valid_domain: Go duration; exact -1ns is whole-history querier sentinel; zero target-dependent; positive must meet computed minimum for filesystem shipper target all
configuration.consumer_effect: Registered0. Target all computes horizon when zero and sets QueryStore=true. Nonfilesystem object store rejects nonzero values in calculateMaxLookBack. Filesystem positive below computed minimum rejects; negative values pass calculator, but only exact -1ns triggers querier whole-history branch. Ingester adjustQueryStartTime clamps only positive durations.
